tagline: Explain it. Fix it. Prove it.
badge_demo_tip: No AI key set: showing pre-made examples; your own text is graded by a simple keyword checker.
h1_explain: Explain it like you're teaching a friend
banner_demo: Demo mode: tap “Try with sample” for a full walkthrough. Your own text works too, graded by a simple offline checker.
explain_ph: Write what you understand, in your own words. Don't look anything up.
why_label: Why do you think it happened?
err_not_error: That doesn't look like an error message.
err_no_key: No AI key is configured, so only Demo mode is available.
err_budget: You've used this session's AI budget. Try the demo or start a new session.
err_ai_busy: The AI is busy right now. Please try again in a minute, or run the demo.
err_demo_custom: Demo mode can't analyse custom text with AI. Use the sample or add an API key.
issue_too_short: That explanation is too short to check.
issue_off_topic: That doesn't seem to be about the topic.
issue_not_an_explanation: That doesn't look like an explanation.
issue_unsafe: I can't work with that text.
lang_note: Lesson content stays in the language you explained in.
no_gaps: No clear gaps. Here are two quick checks anyway.
retest_intro: Answer from memory. These are new questions, not the same ones.
rewrite_note: Rewrite your explanation using what you just learned.
graded_offline: AI grading was unavailable, so a simple keyword checker graded this round.
reveal_negative: Not yet. Review and try again.
uncovered: {n} gap(s) were not retested this round.
comparability: Before and after use the same checkpoints, so they are comparable.
scoring_explainer: Each checkpoint earns 2 points (correct), 1 (partial) or 0 (missing or misconception). Score = 100 × points ÷ maximum, rounded. Scores are computed by code, never by the AI. Bands: under 40 Cracked, 40–69 Taking shape, 70–89 Mended, 90+ Golden.
disclaimer: Feynly is a study aid. The score reflects this one explanation, not your overall ability.
proof_footer: Made with Feynly: Explain it. Fix it. Prove it.
footer_credits: Feynly · built with Claude Code · powered by Gemini
voice_fail: Couldn't transcribe that. Please type instead.
progress_empty: Finish a loop to see your progress here.
teacher_none: No loops found for that class code yet.
teacher_privacy: No names are stored, only the shared class code.
teacher_top: Most common gaps in this class
share_text: I explained “{topic}” in Feynly: {before} → {after}. Explain it. Fix it. Prove it.
